Score future or partially observed units under the fitted scoring basis

Source: R/api-prediction.R
predict_mfrm_units.Rd

Compute conditional posterior EAP ability estimates, posterior SDs, continuous equal-tail CDF intervals (Lower/Upper), optional discrete-grid posterior draws, and optional cut-score probabilities for new_data holding a fitted fit_mfrm() calibration fixed.

Usage

predict_mfrm_units(
  fit,
  new_data,
  person = NULL,
  facets = NULL,
  score = NULL,
  weight = NULL,
  person_data = NULL,
  person_id = NULL,
  population_policy = c("error", "omit"),
  interval_level = 0.95,
  scoring_quad_points = 31L,
  readiness_policy = c("error", "review"),
  n_draws = 0,
  seed = NULL,
  adaptive_quad_points = NULL,
  scoring_prior = NULL,
  cut_scores = NULL
)

# S3 method for class 'mfrm_unit_prediction'
summary(object, digits = 3, ...)

Arguments

fit

Output from fit_mfrm() (method = "MML" or "JML").

new_data

Long-format response data.frame for known non-Person facet levels and optional column-name mappings (defaulting to fit).

person

Long-format response data.frame for known non-Person facet levels and optional column-name mappings (defaulting to fit).

facets

Long-format response data.frame for known non-Person facet levels and optional column-name mappings (defaulting to fit).

score

Long-format response data.frame for known non-Person facet levels and optional column-name mappings (defaulting to fit).

weight

Long-format response data.frame for known non-Person facet levels and optional column-name mappings (defaulting to fit).

person_data

Background covariate data.frame, ID column, and missing-covariate policy ("error" or "omit") for latent-regression MML fits (~ 1 reconstructs IDs automatically; fitted xlevels, contrasts, and spline/scale bases are reused).

person_id

Background covariate data.frame, ID column, and missing-covariate policy ("error" or "omit") for latent-regression MML fits (~ 1 reconstructs IDs automatically; fitted xlevels, contrasts, and spline/scale bases are reused).

population_policy

Background covariate data.frame, ID column, and missing-covariate policy ("error" or "omit") for latent-regression MML fits (~ 1 reconstructs IDs automatically; fitted xlevels, contrasts, and spline/scale bases are reused).

interval_level

Posterior interval level (0.95 default) and Gauss-Hermite node count (31 default, >= 2; inherits fixed vs adaptive mode from fit).

scoring_quad_points

Posterior interval level (0.95 default) and Gauss-Hermite node count (31 default, >= 2; inherits fixed vs adaptive mode from fit).

readiness_policy

"error" (default) refuses non-scoring-ready source fits; "review" labels review-only conditional scores when parameters are finite and valid.

n_draws

Discrete-grid posterior draw count (0 skips draws) and optional RNG seed.

seed

Discrete-grid posterior draw count (0 skips draws) and optional RNG seed.

adaptive_quad_points

Optional integer vector (>= 2 orders >= 3) adding quadrature_review comparisons across fixed and adaptive grids.

scoring_prior

Optional list(mean = ..., sd = ...) overriding the shared normal scoring prior (NULL retains the MML population prior, or N(0, 1) post-hoc reference prior for JML).

cut_scores

Optional strictly increasing named/unnamed ability cuts for unit-weight ordinary RSM/PCM, returning continuous above_cut (\(P(\theta > c \mid y, \widehat\psi)\)) and mutually exclusive ability_band (Lower < ability <= Upper) probabilities in decisions.

object

Output from predict_mfrm_units().

digits

Number of digits used in numeric summaries. Decision probabilities, cut boundaries and scoring priors are not rounded.

...

Reserved for generic compatibility.

Value

An mfrm_unit_prediction list with estimates, decisions, draws, fit_identity, row_review, population_review, quadrature_review, quadrature_overview, input_data, person_data, settings, and notes.

For summary(): An object of class summary.mfrm_unit_prediction with:

  • estimates: posterior summaries by person

  • decisions: unrounded conditional probabilities, when requested

  • row_review: row-preparation review

  • population_review: optional person-level omission review for latent-regression scoring

  • settings: scoring settings

  • notes: interpretation notes

Details

Source and score-integration checks. One- and two-family MML, shared-owner GPCM JML, and corrected JML routes verify local calibration stationarity / curvature (settings$local_calibration_review, SourceScoringReady) and check reported EAP/SD stability (<= 1e-5) against adaptive reference orders (settings$score_integration_review, ScoreIntegrationReady, EstimateUse). All intervals and cut probabilities condition on point calibration and the active prior (PriorSource, PriorMean, PriorSD), excluding calibration estimation uncertainty.

summary() method: Summarize posterior unit scoring output

References

  • Bock, R. D., & Mislevy, R. J. (1982). Appl. Psychol. Meas., 6(4), 431–444. doi:10.1177/014662168200600405 .

  • Mislevy, R. J. (1991). Psychometrika, 56(2), 177–196.

See also

score_mfrm_persons(), score_mfrm_calibration(), classification_table(), apa_table(), fit_mfrm()

predict_mfrm_units() for an executable scoring and reporting example; apa_table(), export_summary_appendix()

Examples

toy <- load_mfrmr_data("example_core")
keep_people <- unique(toy$Person)[1:18]
toy_fit <- fit_mfrm(
  toy[toy$Person %in% keep_people, , drop = FALSE],
  "Person", c("Rater", "Criterion"), "Score",
  method = "MML",
  quad_points = 61
)
raters <- unique(toy$Rater)[1:2]
criteria <- unique(toy$Criterion)[1:2]
new_units <- data.frame(
  Person = c("NEW01", "NEW01", "NEW02", "NEW02"),
  Rater = c(raters[1], raters[2], raters[1], raters[2]),
  Criterion = c(criteria[1], criteria[2], criteria[1], criteria[2]),
  Score = c(2, 3, 2, 4)
)
# Illustrative boundaries only: these labels do not establish CEFR levels.
cuts <- c(Basic = -0.5, Advanced = 0.8)
pred_units <- predict_mfrm_units(toy_fit, new_units,
  scoring_quad_points = 121, cut_scores = cuts)
summary(pred_units)$estimates[, c("Person", "Estimate", "Lower", "Upper")]
#> # A tibble: 2 × 4
#>   Person Estimate Lower Upper
#>   <chr>     <dbl> <dbl> <dbl>
#> 1 NEW01    -0.162 -1.48  1.17
#> 2 NEW02     0.3   -1.02  1.67
pred_units$decisions
#>    Person         Type    Label Lower Upper Probability PriorMean PriorSD
#> 1   NEW01    above_cut    Basic  -0.5   Inf  0.69210796         0       1
#> 2   NEW01    above_cut Advanced   0.8   Inf  0.07706642         0       1
#> 3   NEW01 ability_band    Band1  -Inf  -0.5  0.30789204         0       1
#> 4   NEW01 ability_band    Band2  -0.5   0.8  0.61504154         0       1
#> 5   NEW01 ability_band    Band3   0.8   Inf  0.07706642         0       1
#> 6   NEW02    above_cut    Basic  -0.5   Inf  0.88022925         0       1
#> 7   NEW02    above_cut Advanced   0.8   Inf  0.22964641         0       1
#> 8   NEW02 ability_band    Band1  -Inf  -0.5  0.11977075         0       1
#> 9   NEW02 ability_band    Band2  -0.5   0.8  0.65058285         0       1
#> 10  NEW02 ability_band    Band3   0.8   Inf  0.22964641         0       1
#>                   Status Reason                                Uncertainty
#> 1  available_conditional        conditional_on_point_calibration_and_prior
#> 2  available_conditional        conditional_on_point_calibration_and_prior
#> 3  available_conditional        conditional_on_point_calibration_and_prior
#> 4  available_conditional        conditional_on_point_calibration_and_prior
#> 5  available_conditional        conditional_on_point_calibration_and_prior
#> 6  available_conditional        conditional_on_point_calibration_and_prior
#> 7  available_conditional        conditional_on_point_calibration_and_prior
#> 8  available_conditional        conditional_on_point_calibration_and_prior
#> 9  available_conditional        conditional_on_point_calibration_and_prior
#> 10 available_conditional        conditional_on_point_calibration_and_prior

# Optional prior-sensitivity comparison performs another scoring calculation.
# example("predict_mfrm_units", run.dontrun = TRUE)
if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
apa_table(pred_units, which = "decisions")
# Compare assumptions on the same response rows, without refitting.
alternative <- predict_mfrm_units(
  toy_fit, new_units, scoring_prior = list(mean = 0.5, sd = 1.5),
  scoring_quad_points = 121, cut_scores = cuts
)
comparison <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  "Retained prior" = pred_units$estimates,
  "Alternative prior" = alternative$estimates, .id = "Scenario"
)
if (requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)) {
  ggplot2::ggplot(comparison, ggplot2::aes(Scenario, Estimate)) +
  ggplot2::geom_pointrange(ggplot2::aes(ymin = Lower, ymax = Upper)) +
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(~ Person) + ggplot2::theme_minimal() +
  ggplot2::labs(x = NULL, y = "Posterior EAP",
    caption = "95% posterior intervals conditional on calibration and each prior")
}
# Retain the complete result; summaries and tables do not score again.
saved <- tempfile(fileext = ".rds")
saveRDS(pred_units, saved)
apa_table(readRDS(saved), which = "decisions")
unlink(saved)
} # }
